questions.question: Which component is primarily responsible for executing program instructions?
questions.explanation: The CPU executes the instructions supplied by programs.

questions.question: Which storage usually loses its contents when the computer is powered off?
questions.explanation: RAM is volatile working memory; saved files on persistent storage remain.

questions.question: Why should you keep a separate backup of important documents?
options: To recover files after loss or damage
questions.explanation: An independent backup helps recover data after accidental deletion or device failure.

questions.question: What type of content is Windows Notepad primarily designed to edit?
questions.explanation: Notepad is a plain-text editor; it does not provide rich document layout.

questions.question: Which action creates a second text file while keeping the original file unchanged?
options: Save As with a different file name
questions.explanation: Save As with another file name saves a separate copy.

questions.question: What does the Find command help you locate inside a text file?
questions.explanation: Find searches the document text for the specified characters.

questions.question: Which feature distinguished WordPad from a basic plain-text editor?
questions.explanation: WordPad supported rich-text formatting. Availability varies: Microsoft removed it from newer Windows releases.

questions.question: What happens when you apply bold to selected text in a rich-text document?
questions.explanation: Bold changes the appearance of the selected characters, not their meaning.

questions.question: Which file format historically preserved WordPad rich-text formatting?
questions.explanation: Rich Text Format (RTF) can preserve basic character and paragraph formatting.

questions.question: Which feature applies the same heading format consistently throughout a document?
questions.explanation: Heading styles apply consistent formatting and support document structure.

questions.question: Which tool combines a standard letter with a list of recipients?
questions.explanation: Mail Merge inserts fields from a data source into a common document.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a page break in a Word document?
options: Start following content on a new page
questions.explanation: A page break moves following content to the next page without repeated blank lines.

questions.question: Which formula adds the values in cells A1 through A5?
questions.explanation: SUM with the range A1:A5 includes all five cells.

questions.question: Which cell reference stays fixed when a formula is copied to another location?
questions.explanation: Both the column and row are absolute in $A$1.

questions.question: What does filtering a table normally do to rows that do not meet the filter?
options: Hides them from the filtered view
questions.explanation: Filtering temporarily hides nonmatching rows; it does not delete them.

questions.question: Which view is useful for rearranging the order of presentation slides?
questions.explanation: Slide Sorter displays slide thumbnails for easy reordering.

questions.question: What is the main difference between a slide transition and an object animation?
questions.explanation: Transitions control slide-to-slide changes; animations affect objects within a slide.

questions.question: Which feature helps apply a consistent design across many slides?
questions.explanation: Slide Master controls shared layout and formatting for associated slides.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a primary key in an Access table?
questions.explanation: A primary key uniquely identifies records and supports relationships.

questions.question: Which Access object is used to retrieve records matching specified criteria?
questions.explanation: A query selects and can combine records according to criteria.

questions.question: Which Access object is designed to present data in a formatted printable layout?
questions.explanation: Reports provide structured output suitable for printing or distribution.

questions.question: What should you verify before entering transactions for a company in Tally Prime?
options: The selected company and accounting period
questions.explanation: Selecting the right company and period prevents entries in the wrong accounts.

questions.question: Which voucher is generally used to record money received into cash or bank?
questions.explanation: A receipt voucher records incoming cash or bank amounts; account selection must reflect the actual transaction.

questions.question: Why should opening ledger balances be checked before regular entries begin?
questions.explanation: Incorrect opening balances can distort later balances and reports.

questions.question: What should you check when selecting an item for a sales invoice?
options: Item identity, quantity and applicable price
questions.explanation: Correct item, quantity and pricing are essential for an accurate invoice.

questions.question: Why is the batch number important when managing batch-tracked stock?
options: It identifies the relevant stock batch
questions.explanation: Batch identifiers support stock traceability, including expiry-related tracking when applicable.

questions.question: What should be done before making a major data migration or restore in ERP software?
questions.explanation: A verified backup provides a recovery path if a migration or restore goes wrong.

questions.question: Why are separate layers useful when editing an image?
options: They force all pixels to merge
They allow independent editing of elements
They remove the need to save
questions.explanation: Layers let you edit elements independently without immediately changing others.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a layer mask?
options: Hide or reveal parts of a layer non-destructively
questions.explanation: A layer mask controls visibility while retaining the underlying layer pixels.

questions.question: Which format is commonly used to retain Photoshop layers for later editing?
questions.explanation: PSD preserves Photoshop editing information such as layers when saved with compatible options.

questions.question: Which writing direction is normally used for Urdu text?
questions.explanation: Urdu is normally written from right to left.

questions.question: Why should a document be previewed before printing from a layout application?
options: To check text flow, margins and page layout
questions.explanation: Print preview helps identify layout and pagination problems before using paper.

questions.question: What should you check if Urdu text appears incorrectly after opening a document on another computer?
questions.explanation: Missing fonts or incompatible text encoding/software versions can affect how text is displayed.
